services.value: Provides PFAS testing using novel DART-MS (Direct Analysis in Real Time) and traditional mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS), including rapid chromatography-free screening/quantitation and conventional LC-MS/MS workflows. Offers PFAS testing kits and additional services such as analytical services (analyst hourly rate, LC/MS/MS hourly rate, DART-MS hourly rate), sampling/courier services, sample preparation, and rush services.
